Name: Gustavo's Taco Truck
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Tired of the Saloon's "beige food"? Gustavo offers a real menu with a little more... attitude.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]A New Vendor:[/b] Adds Gustavo, a new slightly-social NPC who is very much inconvenienced by your existence, to the game.
[*][b]The Taco Truck: [/b]Enjoy Gustavo's cuisine through his brand new taco truck in the Cindersap Forest (near the Traveling Cart area).
[*][b]Weekly Schedule:[/b] Gustavo's truck is only open for business [b]every Tuesday[/b] from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
[*][b]Custom Food Items:[/b] The truck sells brand-new, custom food items. Come try them all!
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and most other major content mods.
[*]Compatible with VPR, Earthy, Wittily, and Wayback Pelican Town via Config options
[*]NOT COMPATIBLE with Gus. 
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game and enjoy Taco Tuesday the correct way.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Note: Do not use if you're in love with Gus. Gustavo is EVIL.
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332750.png[/img]
